paite: TOUPA'N Mosi asam a, kihoupihna biakbuk a pan ahoupih a,
heading: Haltum Thillatte
english: Yahweh called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, 'Na lak ua kuapeuh in TOUPA kiang a thillat na lat un, ganhon, bawnghon leh belamhon lak ate, na lat ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to Yahweh, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.

paite: "Athillat pen ganhon lak ate halmang thillat ahihleh apa, gensiatbei alat ding ahi. Amah TOUPA ma a pom ahihtheihna ding in kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah alan ding ahi".
english: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before Yahweh.

paite: Haltum thillat lutung ah akhut akoih dia; huchi in amah a ding in lemna bawlna dia pomsak ahi ding.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

paite: TOUPA ma ah bawngtal agou dia; Aaron tapa, siampute'n asisan alan ding ua, sisan in kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul a maitam atheh ding uhi.
english: He shall kill the bull before Yahweh. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Haltum thillat vun alip dia, asemnen ding ahi.
english: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

paite: Siampu Aaron tapate'n maitam ah mei akoih ding ua, mei tung ah sing achiangkhawm ding uhi.
english: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;

paite: Aaron tapa siampute'n sabakte, alute leh athaute maitam a mei tung ah sing ah kilawmtak in akoih ding uhi.
english: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;

paite: Asungkuate leh akhete tui in asil ding ua; siampu in TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a lat halmang thillat ding in apum in maitam ah ahal ding ahi.
english: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: “Athillat, halmang thillat ding aganhon lak ate, belam hiam, kel hiam ahihleh apa, gensiatbei alan ding ahi".
english: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.

paite: Maitam sik, mallam pang ah TOUPA ma ah agou dia; Aaron tapa, siampute'n maitam kimvel in sisan atheh ding uhi.
english: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before Yahweh. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

paite: Asem ding a, alu toh, athau toh; siampu in maitam tung a mei tung a sing tung ah akoih hoih ding hi.
english: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,

paite: Asungkuate leh akhete tui in asil dia; apum in siampu in alan dia, maitam ah ahal ding hi. TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a lat halmang thillat ahi.
english: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: “TOUPA a dia thillat vasa lam halmang thillat ahihleh athillat ah vakhute hiam, vapalnoute hiam alan ding ahi".
english: “‘If his offering to Yahweh is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.

paite: Siampu in maitam ah ahon tawi dia, alu ahektan dia, maitam ah ahal ding. Asisan maitam pang ah atakkangsak ding ahi.
english: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;

paite: Agongkholh amul toh alakhe dia, maitam kiang, suahlam pang a meivu koihna mun ah apai ding hi.
english: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.

paite: Akhate abottol dia, atak botzak lou in siampu in maitam a mei tung ah ahal ding; huai TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a lat halmang thillat ahi.
english: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
